segments.text: One September day, two hikers were walking high in the Alps when they saw something
segments.englishExplanation: Two hikers were walking in the high Alps when they noticed something unusual.
segments.turkishExplanation: Eylül ayında bir gün, iki dağcı Alpler'in yükseklerinde yürürken bir şey gördüler,

segments.englishExplanation: The object they noticed was frozen inside the ice.

segments.text: At first, they thought it was a lost climber.
segments.englishExplanation: At first, they assumed the body belonged to a recently lost climber.
segments.turkishExplanation: İlk başta, kaybolmuş bir dağcı olduğunu düşündüler.

segments.text: It turned out to be much older.
segments.englishExplanation: In reality, the body proved to be thousands of years old.

segments.text: The most famous natural mummy is Otsi, the Iceman, discovered in a glacier on the Austrian
segments.englishExplanation: Ötzi the Iceman is the most famous naturally preserved body, discovered in an alpine glacier.
segments.turkishExplanation: En ünlü doğal mumya, Avusturya-İtalya sınırındaki bir buzulda bulunan Buz Adam Ötzi'dir,

segments.englishExplanation: The discovery took place near the Italian border in the year 1991.

segments.text: He had lived over 5 ,000 years ago.
segments.englishExplanation: Scientific analysis showed he lived more than five thousand years in the past.
segments.turkishExplanation: 5.000 yıldan daha uzun bir süre önce yaşamıştı.

segments.text: The cold ice had kept his body, his clothes, and even his tools in amazing condition.
segments.englishExplanation: The freezing temperature of the ice remarkably preserved his remains, clothing, and gear.
segments.turkishExplanation: Soğuk buz; bedenini, kıyafetlerini ve hatta aletlerini harika bir durumda korumuştu.

segments.text: Thanks to him, scientists now know what people ate and wore in the Stone Age.
segments.englishExplanation: Because of this discovery, researchers gained important knowledge about ancient human life.
segments.turkishExplanation: Onun sayesinde bilim insanları artık Taş Çağı'nda insanların ne yediğini ve ne giydiğini biliyor.

learningPoints.englishExplanation: Used when something is discovered to be a certain way, especially unexpectedly.
learningPoints.turkishExplanation: Bir durumun sonradan beklenmedik bir şekilde ortaya çıktığını anlatmak için kullanılır.
learningPoints.exampleEn: The test turned out to be much easier than expected.
learningPoints.exampleTr: Sınav beklediğimizden çok daha kolay çıktı.

learningPoints.englishExplanation: Used to indicate that something happened because of a specific person, thing, or event.
learningPoints.turkishExplanation: Bir şeyin kimin veya neyin sayesinde gerçekleştiğini belirtmek için kullanılır.
learningPoints.exampleEn: Thanks to your help, we finished the project on time.
learningPoints.exampleTr: Senin yardımın sayesinde projeyi zamanında bitirdik.

quiz.question: The most famous natural mummy is Ötzi, the Iceman, ______ in a glacier on the Austrian-Italian border in 1991.
